sections.section: RULES - Punjab Information Department Service Rules 1977
sections.description:
PUNJAB INFORMATION DEPARTMENT
PUNJAB INFORMATION DEPARTMENT
SERVICE RULES 1977
(Amendment of Sched.)
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
5th December, 2012]
No.SOR-III(S&GAD)1-19/2006(P),
dated 21-4-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 23 of the
Punjab Civil Servants Act 1974 (VIII of 1974), Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to direct that in the Punjab Information Department Service Rules 1977,
the following further amendment shall be made:--
In
the said rules, in the Schedule:--
(1) at
Sr. No.34, against the post of 'Senior Scale Stenographer (English)', for the
existing entry in column No.7, the following shall be substituted:
"By
promotion on the basis of seniority-cum-fitness
from amongst Stenographers (English) in the functional unit.
If
none is available for promotion, then by initial recruitment."
(2) at
Sr. No.44, against the post of 'Photographer' for the existing entry in column
No.7, the following shall be substituted:
"(i) 2/3rd
by initial recruitment; and
(ii) 1/3rd
by promotion from amongst 'Dark Room Attendants' having matriculation
qualification (second division) and five yeas experience as such."
